edges.reason: Owned constructor writes owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
onlyOwner checks msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before overwriting owner.
The _newOwner argument is written into newOwner by transferOwnership.
Only the owner-triggered call mutates the pending owner slot.
newOwner state variable receives the _newOwner parameter value.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, changing the privileged account.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0) after promotion.
Constructor initializes the symbol state variable.
Constructor initializes the name state variable.
Constructor initializes the decimals state variable.
Constructor mints the fixed total supply into _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the entire supply to the pre-mine address in balances.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing the returned value.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the queried address.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
transfer debits balances indexed by the caller-controlled msg.sender.
The 'to' argument determines the credited balance in transfer.
The 'tokens' argument determines the amount debited and credited.
transfer performs a subtraction on balances[msg.sender] via safeSub.
transfer performs an addition on balances[to] via safeAdd.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for both source and destination.
approve keys the allowed mapping with the caller-controlled msg.sender.
approve writes the granted token amount into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender when decrementing the allowance.
The 'from' argument is debited inside transferFrom.
The 'to' argument is credited inside transferFrom.
The 'tokens' argument drives both balance and allowance arithmetic.
transferFrom updates balances for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the queried pair.
approveAndCall keys the allowed mapping with msg.sender.
The spender argument is both the allowance key and the call target.
The tokens argument is written into allowed before the external call.
approveAndCall writes the granted amount into the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall performs an arbitrary external call to a caller-supplied contract address.
The receiveApproval callback can re-enter approveAndCall and the rest of the token contract.
The tokenAddress argument becomes the target of the external ERC20 call.
The tokens argument is forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token issues an external call to an arbitrarily supplied token contract.
A malicious tokenAddress can execute code that re-enters the token while the rescue call is pending.
safeAdd stores its computed sum in the local variable c.
safeSub stores its computed difference in the local variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists as the credit destination of the transfer function.
The 'tokens' parameter is only used to compute the balance arithmetic inside transfer.
The spender parameter is only meaningful as the allowance key and call target of approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is only written into the allowed mapping inside approveAndCall.
The from parameter is only the debited account of transferFrom.
The to parameter is only the credited account of transferFrom.
The tokens parameter only drives the balance/allowance math of transferFrom.
The tokenAddress parameter only selects the external call target of the rescue function.
The tokens parameter is only forwarded to the attacked ERC20 transfer.
The _newOwner parameter is only stored into the newOwner slot by transferOwnership.
The local c is a temporary result scalar fully contained inside safeAdd.
The local c is a temporary result scalar fully contained inside safeSub.
